description: This file is a shell script for performance testing of 'git for-each-ref' command and related git operations. It sets up refs and tags, runs performance tests with various options, and handles tests for both loose and packed refs.

methods.name: test_for_each_ref
methods.description: Runs performance tests on 'git for-each-ref' with specified arguments for given number of iterations.

methods.name: run_tests
methods.description: Executes a series of performance tests with various options related to refs, tags, and dereferencing.
